method.input: Authorized mobile-playtest.mjs native CDP touch only; maximum two contacts
method.observation: Screenshots inspected with view_image before adaptive inputs; visible UI and map used for decisions
method.environment: Synthetic paused Chromium phone emulation, screenshot scale 3; Software-WebGL fallback enabled, renderer not certified
method.pauses: Driver captured live scenes and paused after acts; visible Resume and CLOSE MAP used to continue. Mission time excludes deliberation pauses.
restrictions_observed: No source, tests, docs, previous reviews or game internals read
No test URL, evaluation, hidden-state access or resource/simulation manipulation
No keyboard or mouse; no custom bot; no other agents
Only new review media/logs and this report written

assessment: Playable and visually coherent on this emulated landscape viewport, with useful objective guidance and successful touch recovery/combat interactions. Precision aiming and close receiver positioning required repeated correction; the dense right-side controls and information overlays reduce the small scene area. This one loss supports a moderate mobile score, not a completion or physical-device claim.

score_scale.overall_method: Holistic judgment from this single observed attempt; not a statistical benchmark or enjoyment rating

overall_mobile.reason: Reached all recoveries and disabled all coils using touch, but repeated aim/position corrections and a crowded viewport made the experience demanding.

controls.reason: Move, hold recovery, reload, fire-drag, scene turn, dash and jump all produced visible responses. Long scene swipe overshot from 027 to 216 degrees, while smaller/fire drags were more precise. Strafe-fire missed; short movement corrections overshot reach. These are observed handling difficulties, not proof of faulty touch registration.

gameplay.reason: Distinct recovery, exposed-coil and dash phase-break decisions were legible and functional. One phase evade and two eliminations registered. Sustained stationary firing was punished; recovery restored resources. Upload survival was not reached.

presentation.reason: Consistent cyan/amber industrial identity, rain, signage, weapon model and recovery/end-screen styling. Close cover sometimes filled much of the scene; no physical-device frame-rate or audio assessment.

usability.reason: Paused map, ground path, automatic next objective, reach-distance prompt and explicit OFF coil states supported progress. Handbook needed scrolling; repeated failed near-receiver holds and map corrections interrupted flow.

readability.reason: Main objectives, health/ammo and final result are readable at 844x390. Map labels, explanatory text and end-screen accuracy line are small; stacked objective/threat/recovery banners and control grid compete with targets.

terminal.custodian: All three coils disabled; objective changed to RETURN TO EXTRACTION

observed_sequence: Read and touch-scrolled the operator handbook, then deployed once.
Held fire at initial centered guard; guard disappeared. Terminal later reported two eliminations; no unsupported per-enemy kill attribution.
Moved northwest using visible path/map; fired imprecisely at sentinel. Recovered Mara at 00:19.
Reloaded and strafed while firing, missed repeatedly and lost shield/health. Dashed toward Heart.
At Heart, moved the wrong direction, made two failed holds, consulted map, backtracked and recovered Sera at 00:41.
Long scene turn overshot; corrected and detoured toward East Archive. Recovered Elian at 00:52.
Reached cover on custodian route; jump plus forward movement cleared it. Consulted map after overshooting approach.
Disabled coil 2 at 01:04. Flanked/reloaded and spent bursts during alignment/armor windows. Disabled coil 1 at 01:20 with health reduced to 38.
Close dash triggered CUSTODIAN PHASE BREAK. First close burst missed coil 3; corrected fire-drag disabled it at 01:25 with health 4.
Attempted turn and dash toward extraction; actual SIGNAL LOST screen appeared at 01:25. Did not retry.

issues.observation: Large scene swipe rotated 189 degrees (027 to 216), requiring correction; fire-drag moved smaller angles.
issues.impact: Coarse turning can lose orientation in a small viewport.
issues.inference: Sensitivity acceleration may contribute; not inspected or diagnosed.

issues.observation: Two Heart hold attempts failed while outside reach; distance changed sharply after short full-deflection movements. Map and backsteps eventually resolved it.
issues.impact: Close positioning required trial and correction under fire.
issues.inference: Floor ring/receiver depth was difficult to judge around cover; reviewer input error also contributed.

issues.observation: Multiple wide status banners occupy upper/middle scene while a large control grid covers the right side.
issues.impact: Less unobstructed scene area for tracking enemies and coils.
issues.inference: Likely more occlusion under real thumbs, untested.

issues.observation: Handbook text and map details require scrolling or close reading at this size.
issues.impact: Guidance exists, but scanning costs attention.

covered: Movement, scene turning, fire-drag, firing, reload
not_covered: Settings, full tactical handbook, recovered-memory reading
Deliberate AIM, SWAP, CROUCH or RUN testing
Physical phone performance, Safari, audio, human enjoyment
coverage.uncertainty: Single synthetic attempt with frequent deliberate pauses. Low accuracy reflects this reviewer’s observed misses and timing as well as possible handling friction; it is not a population usability result. No runtime or implementation diagnosis made.

artifacts.screenshots: All captures retained, including failed holds, misses, detours and terminal scene
